_schema._about: Content for /book. Structure follows the reference get-started page: a slim header (lockup left, one small link right), then a split layout - left column on sand-s with the h1 and, in place of the four-field form, the cal.com embed; right column a full-height dark photo area with a frosted quote card (quote, signature line, name, role, small mark) and, under the card, a row of platform wordmarks (where the reference had its client-logo row) and a small row of seals with a label (replaces 'Enterprise-level security'). The reference's '4:57 reserved' countdown is dropped entirely. British English.
_schema.header: {logo:{file, alt, href}, right:{label, href}} - the reference had a timer at the right; we put the contact email there.
_schema.left: {h1, sub, embed:{provider, url, src, theme, layout, height_min, note, fallback:{label, href}}, expect:{label, items[]}, privacy:{text, link_label, href}} - embed.src is the exact iframe src. It has its own dark theme and must never be colour-inverted or restyled. The embed is the only third-party script on the site and loads only on this page (CONTRACT §11). fallback renders as a plain link under the iframe for viewers who block embeds. expect is a short list beside/under the h1 (14px grey).
_schema.right: {background:{kind, alt}, quote:{text, name, role, signature, mark}, ships_to:{label, items:[{id, text}]}, rights:{label, badges:[{id, label, seal_file}]}} - background.kind = 'video-still': a darkened blurred frame from the hero video (no photography exists). quote is the founder's own statement (real; identical to home.json quotes.items[0].text and agency.json founder.quote). signature = 'name-text' means render the name in the display serif italic instead of a handwriting image. ships_to items render typographically at 60% opacity, monochrome. rights badges render as 40px seals; seal_file is the root-relative path of the SVG under /assets/badges/.
_schema.dropped: The reference's reserved-time countdown and the four form fields (first name, last name, work email, company website) are intentionally absent; the calendar collects those.
